attempts_check_3.name: attempts_check_3
attempts_check_3.value: original_question_id IS NULL OR original_question_id != question_id

confirmed_results_check_2.name: confirmed_results_check_2
confirmed_results_check_2.value: performance IN ('미확인','설명 필요','도움받아 수행','독립 수행','지연 재현')

cost_reservations_check_2.name: cost_reservations_check_2
cost_reservations_check_2.value: actual_units IS NULL OR (actual_units >= 0 AND actual_units <= amount_units)

external_steps_check_3.name: external_steps_check_3
external_steps_check_3.value: state != 'confirmed' OR (external_id IS NOT NULL AND evidence IS NOT NULL)

materials_check_2.name: materials_check_2
materials_check_2.value: origin != 'google' OR (original_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at IS NOT NULL)

quota_reservations_check_2.name: quota_reservations_check_2
quota_reservations_check_2.value: actual_units IS NULL OR (actual_units >= 0 AND actual_units <= weight)

ai_pricing_snapshot.name: ai_pricing_snapshot
ai_pricing_snapshot.value: json_valid(snapshot) AND json_extract(snapshot,'$.id') = id AND json_extract(snapshot,'$.model') = 'gpt-6-luna'

material_inventory_evidence.name: material_inventory_evidence
material_inventory_evidence.value: json_valid(evidence) AND blocked IN (0,1) AND valid_until > checked_at

material_transfer_object.name: material_transfer_object
material_transfer_object.value: write_status != 'succeeded' OR (object_version IS NOT NULL AND etag IS NOT NULL AND actual_hash IS NOT NULL AND actual_bytes IS NOT NULL AND actual_hash = json_extract(metadata,'$.sha256') AND actual_bytes = json_extract(metadata,'$.bytes'))

material_transfer_confirmed.name: material_transfer_confirmed
material_transfer_confirmed.value: state NOT IN ('verified','registered') OR (write_status = 'succeeded' AND validation IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(validation,'$.objectVersion') = object_version AND json_extract(validation,'$.etag') = etag AND json_extract(validation,'$.sha256') = actual_hash AND json_extract(validation,'$.bytes') = actual_bytes)

material_transfer_cleanup.name: material_transfer_cleanup
material_transfer_cleanup.value: state NOT IN ('cleaning','discarded') OR write_status IN ('not-started','succeeded','aborted')
